style.product: Photorealistic studio product photograph for an industrial packaging supplier's catalogue, landscape 3:2 framing. Seamless studio backdrop that is near-white at the top and graduates to a pale cool grey at the bottom, with one soft contact shadow under the subject. Lighting is a single large softbox from the upper left plus a gentle fill from the right, no hard speculars, no colour casts. Camera at a low three-quarter angle just above the product, 50mm lens look, everything in sharp focus, generous even margins, nothing cropped at the edges. Absolutely no text, no printed labels, no logos, no watermarks, no hands and no people. Subject:

jobs.name: pp
jobs.prompt: one large coil of black polypropylene strapping band 12 mm wide, machine-grade, wound tightly and evenly on a brown cardboard core, standing upright on its side so the wound face reads as a clean ring, a second smaller coil of the same black band lying flat behind it slightly out of focus.

jobs.name: pet
jobs.prompt: one large coil of deep green PET polyester strapping band 16 mm wide with the fine embossed cross-hatch texture of polyester strap, wound on a cardboard core and standing upright, held by two white plastic ties, a short loose end of the green band curling away from the coil.

jobs.name: steel
jobs.prompt: one coil of blue-tempered steel strapping band, ribbon-wound so the dark blue-black metal layers stack in a neat flat spiral, lying on its side, with the cut end of the steel band lifting slightly and catching the light.

jobs.name: cord
jobs.prompt: two rolls of woven polyester cord strapping - one roll of black composite corded strap and one roll of green woven polyester strap - the woven fibre texture clearly visible, standing side by side with a short length of the green woven strap laid out in front of them.

jobs.name: film
jobs.prompt: two rolls of clear transparent stretch wrap film on white cardboard cores, one standing upright and one lying in front of it, the loose leading edge of the film pulled out into a soft translucent curl so the light shines through it.

jobs.name: tape
jobs.prompt: four rolls of clear BOPP adhesive packing tape and one roll of brown parcel tape, arranged in a loose overlapping fan, the leading edge of one clear roll peeled up so the light passes through the amber film, plain unprinted tape with no writing on it.

jobs.name: bubble
jobs.prompt: one large roll of clear air bubble wrap with 10 mm bubbles, standing upright, the end sheet unfurled into a soft translucent wave across the front of the frame so the individual bubbles catch the light.

jobs.name: foam
jobs.prompt: one roll of soft white EPE foam wrap sheeting, standing upright with the end of the sheet peeled open into a gentle curl, and two flat cut sheets of the same white foam stacked beside it, the fine closed-cell foam texture clearly visible.

jobs.name: carton
jobs.prompt: one roll of single-face corrugated cardboard partly unrolled so the fluted brown corrugations fan out across the frame, with two flat-folded plain brown corrugated cartons stacked behind it, unprinted kraft brown board.

jobs.name: seals
jobs.prompt: a loose pile of bright galvanised steel strapping accessories - about fifteen open wire buckles and a dozen flat metal serrated seals - heaped together so the polished metal edges catch the light, with three of them laid out separately in front of the pile.

jobs.name: tools
jobs.prompt: a modern cordless battery-powered strapping tool in black and grey plastic with a clipped-in battery pack, standing upright on its base, and beside it a smaller manual steel tensioner tool with a red painted handle.

jobs.name: dispenser
jobs.prompt: a blue powder-coated steel mobile strapping dispenser trolley on two rubber wheels, with a long push handle, a small parts tray at the top and a large coil of yellow polypropylene strapping mounted on its spindle, a length of the yellow band hanging from the coil.

jobs.name: w1
jobs.prompt: a wooden pallet stacked with coils of polypropylene strapping in white, blue, red, yellow and grey, the coils neatly squared up, more wrapped pallets and stacks of plain brown cartons receding into the soft background.

jobs.name: w2
jobs.prompt: a low stack of large deep-green PET strapping coils on a wooden pallet with one coil stood upright on top of the stack, staged in an aisle in front of tall steel racking loaded with more green coils.

jobs.name: w3
jobs.prompt: a single very large coil of black machine-grade polypropylene strapping sitting on a pallet that has been wrapped in clear stretch film, the wound black band filling the subject, stacks of brown cartons behind a wire mesh cage in the soft background.

jobs.name: w6
jobs.prompt: tall steel warehouse racking loaded bay after bay with green PET strapping coils standing on end, receding down the aisle, with one pallet of coils pulled out into the aisle in the foreground.

jobs.name: w4
jobs.prompt: inside a shipping container being loaded, long bundles of dark steel pipe with bright blue plastic end caps laid down the length of the container, each bundle cinched tight with steel strapping bands, the corrugated container walls catching cool daylight from the open doors behind the camera.

jobs.name: w5
jobs.prompt: a large open yard stack of galvanised steel pipe bundles with blue plastic end caps, the bundles banded tightly with steel strapping and stacked in tiers, the cut ends of the pipes facing the camera in a dense honeycomb of circles.
